math: native canonical YAML and public typed Program; no legacy math AST

api.admit: exact lexical source admission -> native load -> static type walk -> canonical roundtrip -> bound leaf
api.reimport: recompute all leaf fields and reject tamper
api.bind_data: exact finite support, coordinate/cardinality and profile-context binding; no predicate execution
api.export_package: canonical JSON over native mathematical bytes, normalized binding and separate audit
api.import_package: revalidate exact source and bindings, recompute every serialized field
api.predicate_client: qualified native predicate signature and required typed references; role checked
api.method_client: typed method signature and finite input context receipt; separate from predicate_client

c2_contract.predicate: named native condition/assumption identity, required symbols and relations, ordered qualified axes, explicit alignment, complete-binary-data limitation
c2_contract.scope: ordered binder declarations; quantifier semantics, nonvacuity, Bool3 and external behaviour remain C2
c2_contract.temporal: explicit chronology reference and native edge policy, no general information/physical boundary proof

c2_method.method_signature: version, fully typed input/parameter/output symbols, native axes and qualified axis identities, quantity and domain rule
c2_method.study_binding: version, method reference digest, data identity/version and OWNER_TBD
c2_method.context_receipt: data digest, typed method signature identity, study identity, leaf identity and combined digest; no actual method evaluation or authority authentication

excluded: sparse native masks or missing defaults
native literal folding in author conditions
